verdict.rationale: M4 Max targets high-end MacBook Pro/Mac Studio designs, not fanless or ultra-low-power machines, and the only battery-life claim (apple-m4-max-docs-6) is vague marketing language with no concrete battery-life benchmarks; community commentary (apple-m4-max-comm-7) explicitly notes the absence of any real battery-run-time data. Missing for 10: evidence of a fanless/thin M4 Max design, independent battery-life benchmarks or hours-of-use figures.
